gen-gf-baloo-da-2-inter: Baloo Da 2 stands almost cap-tall in its lowercase, with wide-set terminals on the s that look confident. And Inter follows with big open counters and a smooth, tube-like line, so paragraphs of it glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-mulish: Baloo Da 2 is loud, with an s that spreads its terminals wide.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-poppins: Wide-set terminals on the s mark Baloo Da 2, and its lowercase rises nearly to cap height. Poppins sits next to it with rope-loose curves and a sturdy, tall body, so the loud heading and the smooth sans-serif feel like a confident shout followed by a steady voice.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-rubik: Rubik reads soft and clean, its lowercase looking big beside the capitals and its round letters staying open at small sizes. But Baloo Da 2 on top brings wide-set s terminals and a near cap-tall lowercase, and that sturdy display weight is what makes the pairing stand out.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-bitter: Towering lowercase letters held open rather than curled shut give Baloo Paaji 2 its presence, and the heading never looks cramped. But Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, grounds it with a dependable, sturdy feel.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-instrument-sans: A towering lowercase, with letters held open instead of curled shut, is what defines Baloo Paaji 2. Instrument Sans follows with c ends pointing apart and a stroke that never varies, so the plain sans keeps the page tidy beneath that tall, smooth heading.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-inter: Commanding in its towering lowercase, Baloo Paaji 2 keeps its letters held open and smooth. But Inter does the quieter work, its big counters and one stroke width keeping a sans text easy to follow line after line.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-mulish: Approachable is the word for Mulish, with horseshoe-open apertures and no thick-and-thin modulation anywhere. And Baloo Paaji 2 above it keeps its towering lowercase, so a long run of the sans body would feel friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-poppins: Baloo Paaji 2 towers with its tall, open lowercase.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-roboto-slab: Tall, open and bold, Baloo Paaji 2 holds its letters wide instead of curled shut. And Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with open throats on a, c, e and s, would settle into a long read with a precise, structured texture.
